scope: Rebase PR #973 onto main d76495da after #953; preserve 9B target/drafter down-projection-only packing and the upstream 4B behavior.
integration_changes: Keep #953 record interleaving and parameter interface; the 9B K=12288 split count and sum order are unchanged.
Exclude new upstream attention, fc and low-rank packed images from the 9B drafter; still 32 target and 6 draft images.
Bind kernel argument 25 to zero in the existing checker because its synthetic images retain pair order. Actual model checks exercise the upstream interleaved images.
performance: Not retimed after rebase. The unchanged validation.json retains the earlier prototype +1.3–1.5% screen with original source identities; it is not a speed claim about this rebased head.
